from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentSummary(BaseModel):
    """One document's metadata needed to filter by cause of action."""
    document_id: str | None = Field(description="The document identifier as labeled (e.g. '判决文书 1')")
    document_title: str | None = Field(description="The title of the document as written in the text")
    document_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of ruling document (e.g. '执行复议裁定书', '再审审查裁定书', '二审裁定书')")
    case_cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The cause of action category stated in the document, as written")
    is_execution_related: bool | None = Field(description="Whether the document type relates to enforcement/execution proceedings")
    quote_summary: str = Field(description="Brief summary of what the document is about, as written in summaries")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentSummary]
